events.verdict: Russell (DAL) legally contests Bridges' (NYK) jump shot attempt.
Washington (DAL), Gafford (DAL) and Towns (NYK) all make contact with the ball as they pursue the rebound.
Gafford (DAL) briefly grasps Shamet's (NYK) arm as they engage for off-ball position.  Shamet maintains his legally obtained position in front of Gafford and Gafford loses his balance on his own.
Hart (NYK) legally contests Washington's (DAL) jump shot attempt.
Shamet (NYK) grasps Gafford's (DAL) left arm as he completes his desired pass with his right hand.
Marshall (DAL) loses control of the ball on his own and not as a result of any contact from Brunson (NYK) or Hart (NYK).
Russell (DAL) goes to, not through, Bridges' (NYK) space as they come together off-ball.
Brunson (NYK) is drawn into the air on the pump fake towards Russell (DAL) and initiates body contact that affects his jump shot attempt.
Gafford (DAL) applies his left arm to Hart's (NYK) side as he contests the shot attempt, and the contact is marginal.
Shamet (NYK) legally contests Thompson's (DAL) jump shot attempt.
Washington (DAL) commits a take foul on Robinson (NYK).
Thompson (DAL) initiates contact with Shamet's (NYK) body that affects his SQBR.
Hart (NYK) legally contests Williams' (DAL) jump shot attempt.
Washington (DAL) dislodges the ball from Robinson (NYK).
Hart (NYK) initiates contact with Washington's (DAL) left arm/wrist that causes Washington to lose control of the ball.
Christie (DAL) commits a take foul on Brunson (NYK).
McBride (NYK) briefly grasps Thompson's (DAL) jersey off-ball.
Wiliams (DAL) illegally hooks Shamet (NYK) on this drive.
Washington (DAL) loses control of the ball on his own and not as a result of the contact from Towns (NYK).
